Traveling with Apple devices usually means bringing a bunch of charging cables and adapters. The RORRY Flow portable charger aims to solve this problem by integrating everything you need into one compact battery. It has a built-in foldable plug, an integrated USB-C cable, and a magnetic charger specifically for the Apple Watch. This type of accessory is exactly my favorite for traveling, handling all charging needs whether on the road or overnight.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers curates the latest and most eye-catching MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you maximize the potential of your wireless charging-compatible Apple devices.

Designed for Travel

The RORRY Flow portable charger has a built-in foldable wall plug on the back, so you can recharge the power bank without carrying an additional adapter. You simply plug it directly into a wall socket at a hotel or vacation rental. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (I really love this design!), allowing you to charge your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, and more even without bringing a cable.

Although I usually focus on MagSafe accessories for the iPhone, this power bank features a dedicated 5W magnetic charger specifically for the Apple Watch. Just place your Apple Watch on it to easily recharge—very convenient. It securely holds the watch and charges it, so you no longer need to bring the original charger when you go out.

This power bank has a capacity of 10,000 mAh, which is more than enough to power your iPhone and Apple Watch for a full day, even on long trips. For me, the most practical feature is its 40W USB-C output, which can even top up a MacBook Air (with the lid closed) in an emergency.

RORRY Flow Portable Charger Summary

If you want to streamline your travel bag for your Apple devices, the RORRY Flow portable charger is a great option. It combines a wall plug, Apple Watch charger, and USB-C cable into one, with a stylish design that easily fits into a handbag or pocket.

You can purchase the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from RORRY or Amazon.
